note: Outcomes read from the provider ledger and the fulfillment records. Never an input to the score.

scenarios.description: A buyer orders, pays in full and the provider reports it
A buyer sends their own price with the order, then pays whatever the shop asks
The provider captures less than the order total and reports the smaller amount
A buyer pays for one order, then a second event for that payment names their other order
An attacker posts an unsigned success event; no money moves
The card is declined and the provider reports the failure
The provider retries one event, sends a second event for the same payment and delivers concurrently
A fulfilled order is refunded in full
A failure event from an earlier declined attempt arrives after the payment succeeded
Fulfillment is down when the payment succeeds, then comes back
The payment is captured but its event never arrives
